item.title: Meet Moïse Kouamé: The 17-Year-Old French-Ivorian Prodigy Making Tennis History
item.description: At the 2026 Miami Open, 17-year-old French-Ivorian phenom Moïse Kouamé made history as the youngest match winner since Rafael Nadal. Overcoming physical cramps, Kouamé defeated American Zachary Svajda 5-7, 6-4, 6-4 to become the first player born in 2009 to win an ATP Masters 1000 match.

item.title: Nigeria’s ‘Big Four’ Lead Record 27 Black Billionaires on Forbes 2026 World’s Richest List
item.description: Nigeria’s Aliko Dangote ($28.5B) remains the world’s wealthiest Black person as a record 27 individuals join the 2026 Forbes list. He leads the Nigerian contingent alongside Abdulsamad Rabiu ($11.2B), Mike Adenuga ($6.5B), and Adebayo Ogunlesi ($2.5B) in a historic year for global Black wealth and industrial influence.
